title: ContextSwitch — take your AI conversations with you
excerpt: ContextSwitch is a browser extension that moves chats between ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini. Available for Chrome and Edge.
content_html:
Chrome + Edge

Copy a thread from ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini and continue it in another provider — without retyping the chat.

How it works

Extract. Choose. Continue.

  1. 01

    Extract the current chat

    Open a conversation on ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini. Click the ContextSwitch icon and extract the thread.

  2. 02

    Pick a destination

    Send the full conversation, the last 10 messages, or the last 20. You choose how much context travels.

  3. 03

    Keep talking

    ContextSwitch opens a new chat and pastes the thread into the composer. You send the message yourself.

Providers

Works with the chats you already use

  • ChatGPT
  • Claude
  • Gemini

Portable files

.chatbridge

Export a conversation as a local JSON file. Import it later and continue in any supported provider. ChatBridge is an open format — the file stays on your machine.

Privacy

Nothing leaves your browser

ContextSwitch does not send conversations to a ContextSwitch server. Transfer reads the current page and inserts text into the destination composer. The extension only requests access to ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini.

Install

Get it for your browser

Listings go live when the Chrome Web Store and Edge Add-ons reviews finish. This page will point at those URLs.
